# #484 hardware measurements

Each cell: **minimum / median / maximum across 3 separate runners** (not pooled percentiles). Units explicitly labelled. Microbenchmarks use the median of 3 repetitions on each runner before computing spread. All other cases are one sequential measurement per runner. No confidence intervals implied; 2–6 second tests. Full runner identities/device settings and per-case raw JSON/text in the artifacts.

Main measurement commit: `e475c4f0ce365a08af654fe29ab6aeea6a75e4c1`. Run: https://github.com/djosh34/tigerstore/actions/runs/42019692789

Actual tigerstore TLS negotiation commit: `c37a536d` (same application source). Run: https://github.com/djosh34/tigerstore/actions/runs/42020335843

Disk case names: `d0` buffered / `d1` O_DIRECT; `pre` overwrites a fully written 1 GiB file per writer; `append` grows a new allocating file; w1/w3 independent writers pinned CPUs 0/0,1,2; b is write size bytes. fio uses psync qd1 with one sync per write, 4 seconds. Independent C companion uses pwrite+sync, 2 seconds, and measures the **whole durable cycle**, not a sum of phase percentiles. fio and companion are separate observations.

**Limits:** These runners use kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure, not the earlier bench kernel 6.17.0-1022-azure. Same N2/4-core/16-GB class, same ext4 options and barrier remount. No power-loss or hypervisor-flush verification. O_DIRECT device reports write-through; durability is the guest syscall contract. p99.9 for large writes has insufficient samples (see samples column); it is an order statistic, not a precise tail estimate. TLS streaming counts bytes accepted by sender before deadline, not confirmed application bytes at receiver; at most a final socket/record backlog can remain. memcpy is cache-hot; streaming memory is 256 MiB per array per thread, above per-VM LLC. Memory numbers are useful bytes and a minimum read+write traffic count, not measured DRAM-controller bandwidth. UDP loss is receiver/kernel loss, not qdisc drops; all recorded qdiscs have zero drops. No physical NIC was measured.
